interface.shortDescription: Guide delivery, refine requirements, design solutions, and keep conversations moving.
interface.longDescription: Eleven conversation skills, including guided delivery, requirements interviewing, and solution design, with focused research and review agents. Use the project's chosen tracker and adaptable working methods. work-guide coordinates the main conversation; requirements-helper captures answers in the canonical draft; solution-helper explains a requirement-mapped design. Existing brain dump, explanation, discovery, handoff, recap, specification check, task-list, and writing skills remain available. Claude loads packaged agents; other hosts can delegate with the supplied role instructions.
defaultPrompt: Help me organize this work item and its next steps
Design a solution for these requirements
Write me a handoff before I clear context
